definitions.explanation: Describes behavior, actions, or handling that is forceful, aggressive, or lacking care. Can describe physical violence or rough treatment.
As a noun, refers to violent or rough actions.

examples.japanese: {乱暴|らんぼう}な{運転|うんてん}はやめてください。
{物|もの}を{乱暴|らんぼう}に{扱|あつか}わないで。
{乱暴|らんぼう}を{働|はたら}く。

notes:
Can function as a na-adjective or a noun. Also used with する as a verb ({乱暴|らんぼう}する = to act violently, to rough someone up).

FORMS:
・{乱暴|らんぼう}な + noun ({乱暴|らんぼう}な{言葉|ことば} = rough language)
・{乱暴|らんぼう}に + verb ({乱暴|らんぼう}に{扱|あつか}う = handle roughly)
・{乱暴|らんぼう}する (act violently toward)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{乱暴|らんぼう}な{運転|うんてん} (reckless driving)
・{乱暴|らんぼう}な{言葉|ことば} (rough/rude language)
・{乱暴|らんぼう}を{働|はたら}く (commit violence)
